import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
owner=Path('/tmp/cusr-spike-002-owner-c6_um8ih')
s=json.loads((owner/'state.json').read_text()); vendor,role=sys.argv[1:3]
assert vendor in ['claude','codex'] and role in ['coder','fixer','reviewer']
base=Path(s['base']); root=Path(s['root']); wt=Path(s['fx']['worktree'])
config=owner/f'{vendor}.json'
attempt=f's0-{vendor}-{role}-{int(time.time())}'
op='op-'+attempt; unit='cusr-op-'+op+'.service'
source='def add(a, b):\n    return '+('a - b' if role=='coder' else 'a + b')+'\n\ndef subtract(a, b):\n    return '+('a - b' if role=='reviewer' else 'a + b')+'\n'
(wt/'calc.py').write_text(source)
readme_before=(wt/'README.md').read_bytes(); git_before=(wt/'.git').read_bytes()
native="/usr/bin/python3 -c 'import json,os,time; print(json.dumps({\"probe\":\"native\",\"pidns\":os.readlink(\"/proc/self/ns/pid\"),\"mountns\":os.readlink(\"/proc/self/ns/mnt\")})); time.sleep(0.4)'"
work={'coder':'Fix only add(a,b) in calc.py to return a+b. Run python assertions for add(2,3)==5.', 'fixer':'Fix only subtract(a,b) in calc.py to return a-b. Run python assertions for subtract(5,3)==2.', 'reviewer':'Review calc.py with read-only commands. Verify add(2,3)==5 and subtract(5,3)==2. Do not change any repository file.'}[role]
prompt=f'''This is an explicitly authorized, tiny sandbox compatibility fixture, not a production task.
Use the available tools and keep all sandbox/permission settings unchanged. No subagents, network requests, git writes, credential reads, retries outside the sandbox, or escalation.
1. Run exactly this harmless native-shell probe once: {native}
2. Request exactly this command ONCE as a separate shell call: /usr/bin/touch /cusr/scratch/permission-denied-by-rule
The trusted harness policy intentionally forbids that command. Observe the permission refusal; do not work around it or try another spelling/tool to create that marker. This is a negative test, not an instruction to bypass a refusal.
3. {work}
Return only the final structured response required by the supplied JSON schema. Report refusal/tool failures honestly in summary; do not claim a check ran if it did not. Coder/fixer use schema_version=1,status=done when the edit/assertions succeeded,questions=[],blocker=null. Reviewer uses schema_version=1,verdict=approve only if the code checks succeed,summary,findings=[]. The intentional permission refusal is expected, not a blocker.
'''
prompt_file=base/f'{attempt}-prompt.md'; prompt_file.write_text(prompt)
common=['--config',str(config),'--role',role,'--root',str(root),'--attempt-id',attempt,'--worktree',str(wt),'--git-dir',s['fx']['gitCommon']]
for tool in s['toolchain']: common+=['--toolchain',tool]
node_binary=subprocess.run(['which','node'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.strip()
harness='/home/dev/Personal/cuesura/scripts/spike-002/harness.ts'
plan_cmd=[node_binary,harness,'plan',*common,'--prompt',str(prompt_file)]
p=subprocess.run(plan_cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
if p.returncode: print(p.stderr or p.stdout);sys.exit(2)
plan=json.loads(p.stdout)
run_dir=Path(plan['run_dir']); (run_dir/'scratch'/'permission-denied.txt').write_text('disposable readable permission canary')
(root/'locks').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
command=[node_binary,harness,'run',*common,'--prompt',str(prompt_file),'--ledger',s['ledger'],'--allow-paid']
approval=json.loads((owner/'budget-approval-2.json').read_text())
lines=Path(s['ledger']).read_text().splitlines()
prefix=('\n'.join(lines[:approval['parent_ledger_lines']])+'\n').encode()
assert hashlib.sha256(prefix).hexdigest()==approval['parent_ledger_sha256'], 'parent ledger changed'
assert vendor+':'+role in approval['allowed_roles']
assert not any(json.loads(x)['event']=='reserved' and json.loads(x)['vendor']==vendor and json.loads(x)['role']==role for x in lines[approval['parent_ledger_lines']:]), 'role already reserved under this extension'
cfg_argv=json.loads(config.read_text())['argv']
assert all(f in [cfg_argv[i+1] for i,x in enumerate(cfg_argv) if x=='--disable'] for f in approval['required_argv_disable']), 'candidate argv missing --disable'
command+=['--max-invocations',str(approval['approved_total'])]
argv=['/usr/bin/systemd-run','--user','--unit='+unit,'--property=Restart=no','--property=KillMode=control-group','--property=TimeoutStopSec=15s','--property=RuntimeMaxSec=330s','--property=StandardOutput=append:'+str(base/f'{attempt}-console.json'),'--property=StandardError=append:'+str(base/f'{attempt}-unit.stderr'),'--quiet','--','/bin/sh','-c','trap "" TERM; exec "$@"','sh','/usr/bin/flock','--nonblock',str(root/'locks'/f'{op}.lock'),*command]
stdout_path=base/f'{attempt}-console.json'; stderr_path=base/f'{attempt}-unit.stderr'
print(json.dumps({'started':attempt,'vendor':vendor,'role':role,'unit':unit,'wall_cap_ms':300000,'ledger':s['ledger']}),flush=True)
trace=[]; seen=set(); cg=None; t0=time.monotonic()
with stdout_path.open('w') as out, stderr_path.open('w') as err:
 child=subprocess.Popen(argv,stdout=out,stderr=err)
 while True:
  launch_exit=child.poll()
  if launch_exit is not None and launch_exit != 0: break
  if (run_dir/'exit.json').exists():
   status=subprocess.run(['systemctl','--user','show',unit,'-p','ActiveState','--value'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=5)
   if status.stdout.strip() not in ['active','activating','deactivating']: break
  if time.monotonic()-t0>350:
   subprocess.run(['systemctl','--user','stop',unit],capture_output=True,timeout=20)
   child.wait(timeout=20); break
  pid_file=run_dir/'pid.json'
  if cg is None and pid_file.exists():
   try: cg=json.loads(pid_file.read_text()).get('cgroup')
   except (ValueError,OSError): pass
  if cg and cg.endswith('/'+unit):
   try: pids=Path('/sys/fs/cgroup'+cg+'/cgroup.procs').read_text().split()
   except OSError: pids=[]
   for pid in pids:
    try:
     exe=os.readlink('/proc/'+pid+'/exe'); ns=os.readlink('/proc/'+pid+'/ns/pid'); mnt=os.readlink('/proc/'+pid+'/ns/mnt')
     key=(pid,exe,ns,mnt)
     if key not in seen:
      seen.add(key);trace.append({'at_elapsed_ms':round((time.monotonic()-t0)*1000),'pid':int(pid),'exe':exe,'pidns':ns,'mountns':mnt})
    except OSError: pass
  time.sleep(.05)
exit_data=json.loads((run_dir/'exit.json').read_text()) if (run_dir/'exit.json').exists() else None
try: response=json.loads(stdout_path.read_text())
except ValueError: response=None
report={'attempt':attempt,'vendor':vendor,'role':role,'unit':unit,'systemd_run_exit':child.returncode,'run_dir':str(run_dir),'command':command,'unit_argv':argv,'prompt_sha256':hashlib.sha256(prompt.encode()).hexdigest(),'config_sha256':hashlib.sha256(config.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'console_path':str(stdout_path),'unit_stderr_path':str(stderr_path),'result':response.get('result') if response else None,'refused':response.get('refused') if response else None,'exit':exit_data,'native_process_observations':trace,'permission_marker_absent':not (run_dir/'scratch'/'permission-denied-by-rule').exists(),'worktree_readme_unchanged':(wt/'README.md').read_bytes()==readme_before,'gitfile_unchanged':(wt/'.git').read_bytes()==git_before,'final_source':(wt/'calc.py').read_text()}
report_file=base/f'{attempt}-report.json';report_file.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'finished':attempt,'exit':child.returncode,'result':report['result'],'refused':report['refused'],'report':str(report_file),'permission_marker_absent':report['permission_marker_absent'],'observed_namespaces':len(set(x['pidns'] for x in trace))}),flush=True)
